still_open: MK-PF-F-015: Define aggregation by holding and tie order; state long-only scope or settle gross-versus-net exposure for shorts.

MK-PF-F-020: Require a common covered span and authentic start weights; for flows use an explicitly decided rebalanced comparator or refuse. Disclose excluded holdings and match scope to the user return.
MK-PF-F-022: Read valid points by date, bound the end to now, require nonnegative integer months and full requested coverage.
MK-PF-F-023: Label this a hypothetical lump-sum, distribution-reinvested comparison before personal taxes and trading costs; require full same-date coverage and finite positive amount.
MK-PF-F-028: Limit to valid transactions through today; state whether gains exclude costs and use distinct security identity for options; refuse missing basis rather than silently drop unknown lots.
MK-PF-F-031: Require finite positive multiplier for options; settle custom nonoption instruments explicitly and refuse invalid stated multipliers rather than quietly use 100.
MK-PF-F-033: Use finite quantity validation and the canonical approved unit/plural list; reject unsupported units.
MK-PF-F-034: Use isDay plus finite price validation and specify duplicate-date conflicts.
MK-PF-F-036: Require valid date and nonnegative integer months; settle impossible local times and use calendar-day arithmetic for financial day spans.
